findings.finding: Portable verifier does not bind record.runtime_sha256_after to retained native identities/text payloads.

Portable verifier does not parse binding1.json to check build_receipt path/hash or selected guarded library against record.guarded_library_sha256, and does not repeat record source-index/artifact-binding relations checked during capture.
Verifier accepts any missing dependency text as native/hash-only without re-deriving external/native-path classification; internal text dependencies should be required as payloads.

positive_findings: Capture native/external branch uses frozen or terminal identity without reading bytes; source/text branch rejects ELF/ar and requires UTF8.
Capture preserves reaped SIGFPE/failed outcomes, execution_complete is distinct from qualification.
Verifier rebuilds content-addressed gzip text fragments without opening historical paths.
scope: Read-only review of capture.py/verify.py and frozen source index before terminal authorization; no run1 contents used for findings.
